structuredContent.markdown:
# Hair editor

Geometry nodes hair and fur, necessary for the hair editor: [mirror1](https://files2.makehumancommunity.org/functional/haireditor.zip), [mirror2](https://files.makehumancommunity.org/functional/haireditor.zip) (12 mb)

## Included assets

This pack contains two blend files (“hair.blend” and “fur.blend”), both by Tomáš Klecer. Each contain template hair styles.
